facts.fact: Google Cloud has one full cloud region in Johannesburg, South Africa, operational since January 2024, per Data Landscapers' audit; no second African region exists.

The Google Cloud Johannesburg region sits inside a Teraco (Digital Realty subsidiary) campus where Google is a tenant, so Teraco's Johannesburg colocation campus is in service; the document gives no opening date, so as_of is its publication date.
